title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow autorollback workflow and telemetry
author: Ayesha Kumar
release_notes: Adds enhanced autorollback telemetry and expands the unified rollouts workflow to ensure safe canary/A-B/shadow deployments. Includes new dashboards, e2e tests, and a migration path for telemetry consumers.
description: Motivation: Improve reliability and observability of unified rollouts by adding richer telemetry for automated rollback decisions and strengthening the canary/A-B/shadow orchestration. This PR implements end-to-end telemetry hooks for rollback triggers, exposes the decision signals to observability, and adds safety guards (quarantine stage and metric quorums) to reduce false positives. What this PR does (high level): Adds telemetry emission points to the rollout engine (decision logs, metric snapshots, quorum results), extends rollout controller to support an explicit 'quarantine' probing stage, updates autorollback policy evaluation to include multi-metric quorum and time-windowed thresholds, updates dashboards and alerts, and includes e2e + load tests to validate behavior under noisy metrics. Also includes small API backward-compatible shape changes to the rollout status payload (added optional fields, documented), plus migration notes. Checklist: [x] Rollout engine telemetry (decision and metric events) implemented; [x] Quarantine stage for probing added; [x] Multi-metric quorum logic for autorollback implemented; [x] Observability dashboards and alert rules added; [x] SDK/client rollout status fields documented; [x] Unit, integration and e2e tests added/updated; [x] Performance microbenchmarks run to validate no >2% median latency regression under typical canary traffic; [x] Release notes and migration guide included. Testing: Unit tests for policy logic and new telemetry schema; integration tests covering canary -> quarantine -> abort/continue paths; e2e test that simulates noisy metric and ensures quarantine prevents premature rollback; load tests to verify batch-path unaffected. CI flakiness detected on e2e on first run; fixed by increasing test timeouts and adding deterministic metric generator. Rollout plan: Merge to main behind feature-flag enabled by default for internal clusters. Gradual rollout to production traffic: enable in staging for 48h, enable for 10% of traffic for 24h, increase to 50% for 24h; monitor new dashboard (autorollback.decisions) and SLOs. Can be quickly toggled off via rollout-feature-flags. Migration notes: Telemetry consumers should handle new optional fields in rollout decision payloads; dashboards shipped include both legacy and new views. No breaking API changes to control-plane endpoints (status additions are optional).
